title.value: A global wildfire dataset for the analysis of fire regimes and fire behaviour

scope_reason: The paper builds a global database of individual wildfire events from MODIS burned area and analyses fire counts, sizes and spread speeds (wildfire occurrence and behaviour).

scope_quote.evidence_text: Here, we present and test a data mining work flow to create a global database of single fires that allows for the characterization of fire types and fire regimes worldwide.
